items.name: Subsistence Agrarian Perimeter and Root Cellars
items.notes: Every pre-industrial settlement across the pointcrawl graph is anchored by an immutable caloric law: the 3-mile transport horizon. Working parts: The Three-Field Rotation Perimeter, Subterranean Dry-Stone Root Cellars and The Spring "Hunger Gap". Communal Granary Bailiff stands against Fallow-Field Sharecropper, while Grain Speculator Miller works the margins and Hedgerow Forager & Swine-Herder bears the cost. Stakes: Spring Hunger Gap Clock [4 ticks] (the Cellar Root-Rot Blight Meter runs alongside) - Each week stored cellars run low without spring greens; full clock triggers Level 4 Famine.
items.yields: Dryland Grain Bushels, Winter Root Tubers, Salt-Pork Rations

items.name: Food: Baseline Subsistence Rations
items.notes: Extracted at The Subsistence Agrarian Perimeter and Root Cellars: The structural crisis of all pre-industrial subsistence occurs between late winter and early summer. Moves as sack, cask or crate (Salt-Pork Rations). It spoils to damp, vermin and rot, so it wants dry lofts, salting or sealed casks and a short route to market. Downstream: In "Granular Mode", socketing this module directly into a node provides Food: Baseline-Subsistence-Rations to satisfy downstream military or industrial prerequisites (e.g. CWT-015 Peasant Levee or CWT-060A Smelting Slag Foundries).
items.yields: Dryland Grain Bushels, Winter Root Tubers, Salt-Pork Rations

items.name: Communal Artesian Well and Village Cistern
items.notes: Water is the absolute chronological ceiling of tabletop survival: a human body survives thirty days without food, but collapses into organ failure within three days without potable water. Working parts: The Dry-Stone Ashlar Shaft, The Counter-Weighted Timber Windlass and The Overflow Cattle Trough & Wash Runnel. Parish Well-Warden stands against Upstream Tanner & Dyer, while Private Cistern Speculator works the margins and Blind Water-Dowser & Dredge Diver bears the cost. Stakes: Aquifer Drawdown & Silt Clock [4 ticks] (the Wellhead Contamination & Typhoid Meter runs alongside) - Each dry month without seasonal recharge; full clock drops head below bucket reach.
items.yields: Potable Artesian Water Flow, Communal Cattle-Trough Access, Settled Lime-Water

items.name: Water: Baseline Potable Well Head
items.notes: Extracted at The Communal Artesian Well and Village Cistern: Water drawn from the well flows first into drinking buckets, then drains into an external curved stone trough for cattle and horses, and finally discharges into a paved gutter irrigating cabbage patches and hemp gardens. Moves as bucket, barrel or flume-flow. It cannot be stockpiled cleanly: stored water fouls within days, so supply is only as reliable as the head, aquifer or cistern behind it. Downstream: In "Granular Mode", it provides Water: Baseline-Potable-Well-Head to satisfy downstream requirements for breweries, foundries (CWT-060A), or hospital wards (CWT-031).
items.yields: Potable Artesian Water Flow, Communal Cattle-Trough Access, Settled Lime-Water

items.name: Water: Baseline Potable Flow
items.notes: Extracted at The Communal Artesian Well and Village Cistern: Worked through the Counter-Weighted Timber Windlass. Moves as bucket, barrel or flume-flow (Potable Artesian Water Flow). It cannot be stockpiled cleanly: stored water fouls within days, so supply is only as reliable as the head, aquifer or cistern behind it.
items.yields: Potable Artesian Water Flow, Communal Cattle-Trough Access, Settled Lime-Water

items.name: Vernacular Timber, Wattle
items.notes: Mundane survival against the elements is not heroic; it is tedious, mud-spattered maintenance. Working parts: Cruck Timber Framing, Wattle-and-Daub Infill Panels and The Thatch & Shingle Weatherproof Cap. Parish Master Carpenter stands against Charcoal-Burner & Shingle Splitter, while Slate Quarry Cartel Factor works the margins and Chimney Sweep & Mud-Dauber bears the cost. Stakes: Municipal Fire Conflagration Clock [4 ticks] (the Rafter Rot & Structural Decay Meter runs alongside) - On high winds, spark-spewing chimneys, or unbaked thatch during drought; triggers town inferno.
items.yields: Hewn Timber Beams, Riverbed Clay Bricks, Split Slate Shingles

items.name: Shelter: Weatherproof Civic Fabric
items.notes: Extracted at Vernacular Timber, Wattle & Stone Masonry: A settlement's civic fabric protects its citizens from hypothermia, predator incursions, windstorms, and smoke-inhalation blindness. Moves as batch (Hewn Timber Beams, Riverbed Clay Bricks, Split Slate Shingles). It moves in discrete lots, and neglect, weather and theft erode a stockpile faster than demand drains it.
items.yields: Hewn Timber Beams, Riverbed Clay Bricks, Split Slate Shingles

items.name: Ditch-and-Palisade with Town Watch Bailiff
items.notes: Peacekeeping in a pre-industrial hamlet does not mean a standing army of knights; it means twelve sleep-deprived tenant farmers armed with rusty billhooks, taking turns standing watch on an earthen embankment in the freezing rain. Working parts: The V-Shaped Earthen Trench & Berm, The Fire-Hardened Log Palisade and The Bailiff’s Gatehouse & Alarm Horn. Parish Town Watch Bailiff stands against Insurgent Smuggler Freeman, while Mercenary Free-Company Captain works the margins and Disgraced Deserter & Trapper bears the cost. Stakes: Palisade Decay & Timber Rot Clock [4 ticks] (the Bandit & Wolf Assembly Meter runs alongside) - In damp seasons without replacement pine stakes; creates breached gaps in perimeter.
items.yields: Sharpened Pine Stakes, Communal Billhooks, Perimeter Alarm Horns

items.name: Defense: Local Palisade and Watch
items.notes: Extracted at The Ditch-and-Palisade with Town Watch Bailiff: The Fire-Hardened Log Palisade: 10-foot sharpened pine and oak poles driven into the crest of the rampart, lashed together with wild hemp cordage and backed by an elevated plank walkway where watchmen can patrol. Moves as batch (Sharpened Pine Stakes, Communal Billhooks, Perimeter Alarm Horns). It moves in discrete lots, and neglect, weather and theft erode a stockpile faster than demand drains it. Downstream: In "Granular Mode", outputs Defense: Local-Palisade-and-Watch, fulfilling prerequisites for trade squares (T0-DOM-05) or tax collection offices.
items.yields: Sharpened Pine Stakes, Communal Billhooks, Perimeter Alarm Horns

items.name: Weekly Barter Square and Village Blacksmith
items.notes: Pre-industrial economies do not run on shiny gold coins; ordinary peasants may go five years without seeing a single silver piece. Working parts: The Charcoal Smithy, The Barter Cross & Market Square and Standard Metrology & Tally-Sticks. Village Master Blacksmith stands against Itinerant Tinker & Peddler, while Town Coin-Clipper & Moneylender works the margins and Bog-Iron Smelter & Charcoaler bears the cost. Stakes: Charcoal Reserve Depletion Clock [4 ticks] (the Scrap Iron Famine Meter runs alongside) - When highland timber supply lines are blocked; cold hearth halts tool fabrication.
items.yields: Forged Iron Plowshares, Draft-Horse Shoes, Hand-Woven Wool Homespun

items.name: Economy: Baseline Mundane Smithy and Trade
items.notes: Extracted at The Weekly Barter Square and Village Blacksmith: Mundane survival is held together by two physical institutions: the charcoal-fired village forge and the weekly open-air barter square. Moves as batch (Forged Iron Plowshares, Draft-Horse Shoes, Hand-Woven Wool Homespun). It moves in discrete lots, and neglect, weather and theft erode a stockpile faster than demand drains it. Downstream: In "Granular Mode", outputs Economy: Baseline-Mundane-Smithy-and-Trade, satisfying requirements for fortifications (T0-DOM-04) and masonry (T0-DOM-03).
items.yields: Forged Iron Plowshares, Draft-Horse Shoes, Hand-Woven Wool Homespun

items.name: Village Herbalist, Midwife
items.notes: In pre-industrial campaign settings, there are no clerical miracle-workers casting Cure Light Wounds on every sick child or blistered plowman. Working parts: The Drying Rafters & Hedgerow Foraging, The Glazed Leech Jars & Bone-Setting Splints and The Childbed Steam Hearth. Parish Elder Midwife stands against Wandering Faith-Healer Peddler, while Quack Apothecary & Arsenic Dealer works the margins and Hedgerow Witch & Leper Hermit bears the cost. Stakes: Hedgerow Herbal Exhaustion Clock [4 ticks] (the Contagious Pestilence Outbreak Meter runs alongside) - In winter or drought when hedgerows freeze; cuts healing potency by half.
items.yields: Dried Willow Bark Bundles, Yarrow Wound-Salve, Clean Boiled Linen Rolls

items.name: Health: Folk Leechcraft and Midwifery
items.notes: Extracted at The Village Herbalist, Midwife & Leechcraft Hearth: Mundane survival against dysentery, broken femur fractures, and maternal mortality rests entirely in the hands of the village midwife and herbalist hearth. Moves as batch (Dried Willow Bark Bundles, Yarrow Wound-Salve, Clean Boiled Linen Rolls). It moves in discrete lots, and neglect, weather and theft erode a stockpile faster than demand drains it. Downstream: In "Granular Mode", outputs Health: Folk-Leechcraft-and-Midwifery, fulfilling requirements for military garrisons (T0-DOM-04) and mining camps.
items.yields: Dried Willow Bark Bundles, Yarrow Wound-Salve, Clean Boiled Linen Rolls

items.name: Midden Trenches, Swine Scavengers
items.notes: Before the invention of subterranean vitreous clay sewer pipes or municipal water mains, human settlements survived only by managing their own waste through three rigorous pre-industrial technologies: compost midden trenches, scavenger swine corrals, and slake... Working parts: The Graded Midden Trenches, The Scavenger Swine Pen and The Slaked-Lime Night-Soil Pit. Parish Midden-Master stands against Night-Soil Farmer & Carter, while Slaked-Lime Kiln Cartel Factor works the margins and Midden Mudlark & Bone-Picker bears the cost. Stakes: Midden Overflow & Fly Swarm Clock [4 ticks] (the Cholera Aquifer Seepage Meter runs alongside) - In wet summer heat or when manure carting halts; spills effluent into living lanes.
items.yields: Composted Agricultural Manure, Cured Slaked Lime Powder, Scavenger Swine Hides

items.name: Sanitation: Vernacular Midden Management
items.notes: Extracted at The Midden Trenches, Swine Scavengers & Night-Soil Pit: A communal herd of thirty hardy, aggressive razorback pigs confined to a fortified timber corral beside the midden. Moves as batch (Composted Agricultural Manure, Cured Slaked Lime Powder, Scavenger Swine Hides). It moves in discrete lots, and neglect, weather and theft erode a stockpile faster than demand drains it. Downstream: In "Granular Mode", outputs Sanitation: Vernacular-Midden-Management, protecting connected nodes from waterborne plague and epidemic clocks.
items.yields: Composted Agricultural Manure, Cured Slaked Lime Powder, Scavenger Swine Hides

items.name: Wayside Boundary Shrine
items.notes: A human settlement is not merely a collection of caloric stomachs and timber roofs; it is a psychological pact against the terrifying darkness of the wild frontier. Working parts: The Wayside Boundary Cairn, The Parish Perambulation ("Beating the Bounds") and The Perpetual Hearth Vigil & Threshold Salt. Parish Hearth-Elder stands against Purifying Iconoclast Zealot, while Superstitious Blood-Diviner works the margins and The Mute Sin-Eater Hermit bears the cost. Stakes: Sacred Taboo Desecration Clock [4 ticks] (the Clan Paranoia & Witch-Hunt Meter runs alongside) - When outsiders violate boundary markers or ancient oaks are felled; provokes communal dread.
items.yields: Carved Wooden Boundary Effigies, Blessed Solstice Honey Cakes, Hearth-Ash Ward Salt

items.name: Social: Communal Folklore Solidarity
items.notes: Extracted at The Wayside Boundary Shrine & Hearth Vigil: Every family keeps a single coal burning continuously beneath ash in their hearth, rekindled each winter solstice from a communal central bonfire. Moves as batch (Carved Wooden Boundary Effigies, Blessed Solstice Honey Cakes, Hearth-Ash Ward Salt). It moves in discrete lots, and neglect, weather and theft erode a stockpile faster than demand drains it. Downstream: In "Granular Mode", outputs Social: Communal-Folklore-Solidarity, preventing fear, despair, and civil revolt clocks across adjacent nodes.
items.yields: Carved Wooden Boundary Effigies, Blessed Solstice Honey Cakes, Hearth-Ash Ward Salt

items.name: Sugarcane Plantation and Harvest Fields
items.notes: The sugarcane fields form the agricultural engine of the coastal river bottom, converting tropical humidity and deep volcanic loam into mountain-high stacks of dense, sucrose-rich cane. Working parts: Alluvial Drainage Canals, Cane Brake Stands and Ox-Cart Weigh Station. Stakes: Red Rot Blight Clock [4 ticks] (the Cutter Strike Clock runs alongside) - Spores infect stalks if drainage trenches stagnate.
items.yields: Bundled Raw Sugarcane Stalks (10 Tons/Day)

items.name: Crop: Raw Sugarcane
items.notes: Extracted at Sugarcane Plantation and Harvest Fields: Worked through the Alluvial Drainage Canals. Moves as cartload or hopper-fill (Bundled Raw Sugarcane Stalks (10 Tons/Day)). It is harvest-seasonal and bulky; hoppers and ricks must stay dry or the lot heats, moulds and is written off. Downstream: Dispatches cartloads of Crop: Raw-Sugarcane to the Cane Crushing Mill & Boiling House (AGRI-SUGAR-02).
items.yields: Bundled Raw Sugarcane Stalks (10 Tons/Day)

items.name: Cane Crushing Mill and Boiling House
items.notes: The crushing mill and boiling house forms the industrial core of sugar manufacture, extracting sticky juice between iron rollers and evaporating it across a cascading furnace train. Working parts: Three-Roller Iron Mill, The Jamaica Boiling Train and Curing Hogshead Loft. Stakes: Roller Jam Clock [4 ticks] (the Boiler Pressure Clock runs alongside) - Fiber tangles iron teeth if greasing fails.
items.yields: Granulated Sugar Loaves & Heavy Blackstrap Molasses Vats

items.name: Commodity: Cane Molasses
items.notes: Refined at Cane Crushing Mill and Boiling House: Open-beamed timber loft where conical clay pots drain black molasses from the crystalline sugar loaves. Moves as bale, hogshead or crate (Heavy Blackstrap Molasses Vats). It travels in tallied lots; damp, pilferage and short-weight customs fees are the usual losses. Downstream: Dispatches casks of Food: Refined-Sugar to commercial markets and vats of Commodity: Cane-Molasses to the Rum Distillery & Excise Harbor (AGRI-SUGAR-03).
items.yields: Granulated Sugar Loaves & Heavy Blackstrap Molasses Vats

items.name: Food: Refined Sugar
items.notes: Refined at Cane Crushing Mill and Boiling House: Worked through the Jamaica Boiling Train. Moves as sack, cask or crate (Granulated Sugar Loaves). Downstream: Dispatches casks of Food: Refined-Sugar to commercial markets and vats of Commodity: Cane-Molasses to the Rum Distillery & Excise Harbor (AGRI-SUGAR-03).
items.yields: Granulated Sugar Loaves & Heavy Blackstrap Molasses Vats

items.name: Rum Distillery and Excise Harbor
items.notes: Stationed at the interface of fresh river water and ocean trade winds, the rum distillery converts refinery waste byproducts into the primary maritime trade currency of the realm. Working parts: Dunder & Skimmings Cisterns, Gooseneck Copper Pot Stills and Bonded Rum Wharf & Cooperage. Stakes: Excise Raid Clock [4 ticks] (the Vat Souring Clock runs alongside) - Revenue cutters search for untaxed spirit casks.

It travels in tallied lots; damp, pilferage and short-weight customs fees are the usual losses. Downstream: Exports Commodity: High-Proof-Rum across regional sea lanes and satisfies military tavern rations.
items.yields: Tier 1 Export Navy Rum Barrels (50 Casks/Week)

items.name: Alunite Quarry
items.notes: Volcanic alunite rock is quarried from arid hillsides, broken into manageable fragments, and roasted in specialized kilns to drive off sulfur gases. Stakes: The Sulfur Leak - When a cracked roasting kiln releases choking sulfur dioxide across the compound, Alistair must seal the breach before local authorities shut down the operation.

items.yields: Potassium Alum (Purified crystalline mordant used to fix dyes in textiles.)

items.name: Subsistence Agrarian Perimeter and Root Cellars
items.notes: Every pre-industrial settlement across the pointcrawl graph is anchored by an immutable caloric law: the 3-mile transport horizon. Working parts: The Three-Field Rotation Perimeter, Subterranean Dry-Stone Root Cellars and The Spring "Hunger Gap". Communal Granary Bailiff stands against Fallow-Field Sharecropper, while Grain Speculator Miller works the margins and Hedgerow Forager & Swine-Herder bears the cost. Stakes: Spring Hunger Gap Clock [4 ticks] (the Cellar Root-Rot Blight Meter runs alongside) - Each week stored cellars run low without spring greens; full clock triggers Level 4 Famine.

items.name: Food: Baseline Subsistence Rations

Moves as sack, cask or crate (Salt-Pork Rations). It spoils to damp, vermin and rot, so it wants dry lofts, salting or sealed casks and a short route to market. Downstream: In "Granular Mode", socketing this module directly into a node provides Food: Baseline-Subsistence-Rations to satisfy downstream military or industrial prerequisites (e.g. CWT-015 Peasant Levee or CWT-060A Smelting Slag Foundries).

items.name: Communal Artesian Well and Village Cistern

Working parts: The Dry-Stone Ashlar Shaft, The Counter-Weighted Timber Windlass and The Overflow Cattle Trough & Wash Runnel. Parish Well-Warden stands against Upstream Tanner & Dyer, while Private Cistern Speculator works the margins and Blind Water-Dowser & Dredge Diver bears the cost. Stakes: Aquifer Drawdown & Silt Clock [4 ticks] (the Wellhead Contamination & Typhoid Meter runs alongside) - Each dry month without seasonal recharge; full clock drops head below bucket reach.
items.yields: Potable Artesian Water Flow, Communal Cattle-Trough Access, Settled Lime-Water

items.name: Water: Baseline Potable Well Head
items.notes: Extracted at The Communal Artesian Well and Village Cistern: Water drawn from the well flows first into drinking buckets, then drains into an external curved stone trough for cattle and horses, and finally discharges into a paved gutter irrigating cabbage patches and hemp gardens. Moves as bucket, barrel or flume-flow. It cannot be stockpiled cleanly: stored water fouls within days, so supply is only as reliable as the head, aquifer or cistern behind it. Downstream: In "Granular Mode", it provides Water: Baseline-Potable-Well-Head to satisfy downstream requirements for breweries, foundries (CWT-060A), or hospital wards (CWT-031).
items.yields: Potable Artesian Water Flow, Communal Cattle-Trough Access, Settled Lime-Water

Stakes: The Leaky Seam - Bramble Finch discovers a major seawater leak along the garboard strake during the initial drydock flood test, requiring immediate emergency pitching.
items.yields: Careened Hull

items.name: Naval: Careened Hull
items.notes: Manufactured at Drydock Slipway & Caulking Yard: Complete, watertight wooden ship hull ready for masts and rigging. Moves as batch (Careened Hull). It moves in discrete lots, and neglect, weather and theft erode a stockpile faster than demand drains it.
items.yields: Careened Hull

items.name: Admiralty Fitting-Out Basin
items.notes: The admiralty fitting-out basin represents the pinnacle of pre-industrial maritime manufacturing. Stakes: The Unstepped Mast - Commodore Alistair Vance threatens to withhold commissioning funds unless the rigging crew steps the mainmast before the royal inspection at dawn.
items.yields: Ocean Caravel

items.name: Transport: Ocean Caravel
items.notes: Manufactured at Admiralty Fitting-Out Basin: Fully rigged, seaworthy multi-masted sailing ship ready for deep-ocean exploration. Moves as batch (Ocean Caravel). It moves in discrete lots, and neglect, weather and theft erode a stockpile faster than demand drains it.
items.yields: Ocean Caravel

items.name: Filature Reeling Basin
items.notes: The filature reeling basin is a steaming workshop equipped with rows of copper water cauldrons heated by wood-fired brick stoves. Stakes: The Boiling Surge - Stoker Baator overheats the primary cauldron, threatening to snap the delicate silk filaments currently being reeled by Master Reeler Xiulan.
items.yields: Reeled-Silk-Thread (Continuous, lustrous filament reeled from multiple cocoons into strong raw yarn.)

items.name: Textile: Reeled Silk Thread
items.notes: Refined at Filature Reeling Basin: Continuous, lustrous filament reeled from multiple cocoons into strong raw yarn. Moves as bale, hogshead or crate (Reeled-Silk-Thread (Continuous). It travels in tallied lots; damp, pilferage and short-weight customs fees are the usual losses.
items.yields: Reeled-Silk-Thread (Continuous, lustrous filament reeled from multiple cocoons into strong raw yarn.)

items.name: Drawloom Brocade Atelier
items.notes: The drawloom brocade atelier is an elite, quiet workshop dominated by massive complex drawlooms operated by paired weavers and draw-boys. Stakes: The Tangled Draw-Cord - Draw-Boy Kavi accidentally snaps a primary pattern cord, threatening to ruin a rush commission of imperial silk-brocade.
items.yields: Silk-Brocade (Heavy, sumptuous fabric interwoven with gold threads and intricate dyed patterns.)

items.name: Luxury: Silk Brocade
items.notes: Manufactured at Drawloom Brocade Atelier: Heavy, sumptuous fabric interwoven with gold threads and intricate dyed patterns. Moves as batch (Silk-Brocade (Heavy). It moves in discrete lots, and neglect, weather and theft erode a stockpile faster than demand drains it.
items.yields: Silk-Brocade (Heavy, sumptuous fabric interwoven with gold threads and intricate dyed patterns.)

items.name: Stamping Mill
items.notes: Raw galena ore is crushed to fine powder by heavy iron-shod stamping hammers powered by waterwheels, then spread across a vast paved stone patio. Stakes: The Quicksilver Leak - A subterranean drainage pipe fractures, bleeding toxic mercury into the municipal river and sparking immediate panic among downstream farmers.
items.yields: Crude Bullion

items.name: Metal: Crude Bullion
items.notes: Refined at Stamping Mill & Patio Amalgamation Floor: Raw galena ore is crushed to fine powder by heavy iron-shod stamping hammers powered by waterwheels, then spread across a vast paved stone patio. Moves as ingot, ore-cart or pig (Crude Bullion). It is dense and wagon-bound; ore heaps weather, ingots tempt thieves, and every haul is a labour and axle problem.
items.yields: Crude Bullion

items.name: Ore: Lead Slag
items.notes: Refined at Cupellation Hearth & Sovereign Mint: Spent bone-ash litharge cakes and hearth slag are broken out of the cupel hearth and carted to the lead bole for resmelting. Moves as ingot, ore-cart or pig (Lead Slag). It is dense and wagon-bound; ore heaps weather, ingots tempt thieves, and every haul is a labour and axle problem.
items.yields: Silver Coinage, Lead Slag

items.name: Cupellation Hearth
items.notes: Crude bullion is melted in bone-ash cupels inside a draft-controlled hearth, where an oxidizing blast burns away base lead and base impurities into the porous hearth lining. Stakes: The Clipped Shillings - An audit reveals widespread coin clipping originating within the mint guards, threatening Lord Valerian with treason charges if he fails to unmask the ringleader.
items.yields: Silver Coinage, Lead Slag

items.name: Currency: Silver Coinage
items.notes: Manufactured at Cupellation Hearth & Sovereign Mint: Hardened tool-steel punch engraved with the sovereign's likeness and mint marks. Moves as batch (Silver Coinage). It moves in discrete lots, and neglect, weather and theft erode a stockpile faster than demand drains it.
items.yields: Silver Coinage, Lead Slag

items.name: Civic Bakehouse
items.notes: The civic bakehouse features cavernous brick-lined ovens heated by intense hardwood fires until the masonry radiates steady baking heat. Stakes: The Scarcity Loaf - When dwindling wood fuel threatens to shut down the ovens mid-baking, Martha must negotiate emergency timber allotments while guarding the remaining dough from desperate citizens.
items.yields: Baked-Bread (Dense, crusty loaves stamped with the municipal weight seal.)

items.name: Food: Baked Bread
items.notes: Manufactured at Civic Bakehouse: Dense, crusty loaves stamped with the municipal weight seal. Moves as sack, cask or crate (Baked-Bread (Dense). It spoils to damp, vermin and rot, so it wants dry lofts, salting or sealed casks and a short route to market.
items.yields: Baked-Bread (Dense, crusty loaves stamped with the municipal weight seal.)

items.name: Tryworks Rendering Furnace
items.notes: The tryworks facility houses double copper rendering vats set into massive brick masonry furnaces. Stakes: The Scorched Batch - Ezra Thorne battles a runaway fire in the rendering sheds after a crackling-fed furnace overheats, threatening thousands of gallons of stored oil.
items.yields: Whale Oil

items.name: Light: Whale Oil
items.notes: Refined at Tryworks Rendering Furnace: Clear, combustible amber oil prized for street lamps and heavy machinery lubrication. Moves as batch (Whale Oil). It moves in discrete lots, and neglect, weather and theft erode a stockpile faster than demand drains it.
items.yields: Whale Oil

items.name: Copper Alembic Distillery
items.notes: Hand-hammered copper pot stills featuring long cooling condensers and water jackets sit over controlled masonry hearths. Stakes: The Scorched Mash - A sudden draft stokes the hearth of Bram Mason too fiercely, threatening to ruin Master Alchemist Vespera Drake's entire batch of high-grade spirit unless the heat is immediately damped and redirected...
items.yields: Chem: Distilled-Spirits (Highly concentrated ethanol solution used for medicine, solvents, and potent potables.)

items.name: Chem: Distilled Spirits
items.notes: Manufactured at Copper Alembic Distillery: Highly concentrated ethanol solution used for medicine, solvents, and potent potables. Moves as sealed cask or lead-lined keg (Chem: Distilled-Spirits (Highly concentrated ethanol solution used for medicine). It is caustic or toxic in bulk, needs lead, glass or glazed vessels, and a single contaminated batch can ruin a whole run.
items.yields: Chem: Distilled-Spirits (Highly concentrated ethanol solution used for medicine, solvents, and potent potables.)

items.name: Wine Press
items.notes: Subterranean stone-vaulted cellars maintain cool, stable temperatures ideal for fermentation. Stakes: The Spiked Cask - A rogue heat wave threatens the main aging stock of Lucian Vance, prompting Silas Cole to haul cold spring water through the cellars to cool the barrels before the prized vintage spoils entirely.
items.yields: Food: Vintage-Wine (Fermented grape juice aged to complex aromatic perfection.); Chem: Wine-Vinegar (Sharp, acetic acid solution used for food preservation and cleaning.)

items.name: Food: Vintage Wine
items.notes: Refined at Wine Press & Fermenting Cellar: Fermented grape juice aged to complex aromatic perfection. Moves as sack, cask or crate (Food: Vintage-Wine). It spoils to damp, vermin and rot, so it wants dry lofts, salting or sealed casks and a short route to market.
items.yields: Food: Vintage-Wine (Fermented grape juice aged to complex aromatic perfection.); Chem: Wine-Vinegar (Sharp, acetic acid solution used for food preservation and cleaning.)

items.name: Chem: Wine Vinegar
items.notes: Refined at Wine Press & Fermenting Cellar: Fermented grape juice aged to complex aromatic perfection. Moves as sealed cask or lead-lined keg (Chem: Wine-Vinegar (Sharp). It is caustic or toxic in bulk, needs lead, glass or glazed vessels, and a single contaminated batch can ruin a whole run.
items.yields: Food: Vintage-Wine (Fermented grape juice aged to complex aromatic perfection.); Chem: Wine-Vinegar (Sharp, acetic acid solution used for food preservation and cleaning.)

items.name: Tin Blowing House
items.notes: The tin blowing house is a thick-walled stone furnace shed equipped with a large leather-and-wood foot-or-water-driven bellows. Stakes: The Arsenical Choke - Dangerous arsenic vapors escape a cracked hearthstone, incapacitating Jory Polglase and threatening a stoppage unless Master Geoffrey procures refractory clay repairs.
items.yields: Tin Ingot

items.name: Metal: Tin Ingot
items.notes: Refined at Tin Blowing House: Workers charge the granite hearth with alternate layers of washed cassiterite ore and charcoal fuel, producing high blast temperatures that reduce the oxide to molten white metal. Moves as ingot, ore-cart or pig (Tin Ingot). It is dense and wagon-bound; ore heaps weather, ingots tempt thieves, and every haul is a labour and axle problem.
items.yields: Tin Ingot

items.name: Bark Crushing Mill
items.notes: A rustic timber-framed water- or animal-powered pounder mill utilizes heavy stone stamps or iron-shod wooden beams to pulverize coarse oak and hemlock tree bark into a fibrous powder. Stakes: The Splintered Cam - Master Alistair discovers a cracked wooden drive cam just as a large shipment of oak bark arrives. He enlists Giles and local adventurers to source seasoned heartwood before the milling schedule stall...
items.yields: Tannin

items.name: Chem: Tannin
items.notes: Refined at Bark Crushing Mill: This mechanical transformation turns raw, bulky forest litter into concentrated tanning extract essential for hide preservation. Moves as sealed cask or lead-lined keg (Tannin). It is caustic or toxic in bulk, needs lead, glass or glazed vessels, and a single contaminated batch can ruin a whole run.
items.yields: Tannin

items.name: Crucible Steelworks and Foundry
items.notes: Wootz Crucible Steel Ingots & Rifled Artillery Castings (5 Tons/Day). Working parts: Sunken Coke Melting Holes, Graphite Clay Crucibles and Overhead Pivot Cranes & Water Trip-Hammer. Stakes: Pot Fracture Clock [4 ticks] (the Cast Porosity Clock runs alongside) - Rapid temperature swings crack clay crucibles.
items.yields: Wootz Crucible Steel Ingots & Rifled Artillery Castings (5 Tons/Day)

items.name: Alloy: Crucible Steel
items.notes: Produced at Crucible Steelworks and Foundry: The crucible steel foundry represents the pinnacle of island pyrotechnics, fusing brittle pig-iron and refined fuel inside sealed clay vessels to cast homogenous, razor-keen crucible steel. Moves as ingot, ore-cart or pig (Wootz Crucible Steel Ingots). It is dense and wagon-bound; ore heaps weather, ingots tempt thieves, and every haul is a labour and axle problem. Downstream: Produces sovereign-grade Alloy: Crucible-Steel for master weapon smiths and casts Commodity: Heavy-Ordnance for coastal bastions.
items.yields: Wootz Crucible Steel Ingots & Rifled Artillery Castings (5 Tons/Day)

items.name: Commodity: Heavy Ordnance
items.notes: Produced at Crucible Steelworks and Foundry: Cast-iron swinging crane with tongs used by heat-masked puller-outs to extract glowing pots, teaming the steel into cast-iron cannon molds and heavy forging anvils. Moves as bale, hogshead or crate (Rifled Artillery Castings (5 Tons/Day)). It travels in tallied lots; damp, pilferage and short-weight customs fees are the usual losses. Downstream: Produces sovereign-grade Alloy: Crucible-Steel for master weapon smiths and casts Commodity: Heavy-Ordnance for coastal bastions.
items.yields: Wootz Crucible Steel Ingots & Rifled Artillery Castings (5 Tons/Day)

items.name: Firing Woks
items.notes: Equipped with massive cast-iron woks, brick flues, and tiered bamboo drying racks, this processing station halts enzymatic decay in raw agricultural crops through controlled heat application. Stakes: -- - A sudden draft flares the primary flues, charring a high-value tea shipment intended for the provincial governor's palace.
items.yields: Cured-Spices-and-Tea (Highly valuable, shelf-stable aromatics packaged for luxury trade routes.)

items.name: Luxury: Cured Spices and Tea
items.notes: Refined at Firing Woks & Curing Sheds: Highly valuable, shelf-stable aromatics packaged for luxury trade routes. Moves as batch (Cured-Spices-and-Tea (Highly valuable). It moves in discrete lots, and neglect, weather and theft erode a stockpile faster than demand drains it.
items.yields: Cured-Spices-and-Tea (Highly valuable, shelf-stable aromatics packaged for luxury trade routes.)
